verdicts.reason: Both shrink the crowd illustration to a thumbnail-sized strip and reduce the coral Margaret Mead attribution to an illegible grey speck, which loses a key brand colour and the quote's source. A puts the quote first and leaves the tiny crowd floating on the right with dead space around it. B keeps the original reading order (crowd, then quote) in a more natural left-to-right banner, but its quote is cramped against the right edge and the crowd is still too small to work as imagery.
